# Tsung-Han Yang, Ph.D.

> Materials physicist working on AI for Science: physics-grounded ML and LLM-agent tools for scattering data, and browser-based scientific software for structure refinement, diffuse scattering and Reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) analysis. Postdoctoral researcher at Oak Ridge National Laboratory; Ph.D. in Physics, Brown University.

The software projects listed here are independent, personal open-source work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://drthyang.github.io/): overview, capabilities and recent highlights
- [About](https://drthyang.github.io/about/): background, technical strengths and education
- [Research](https://drthyang.github.io/research/): LLM agents for scattering analysis; topology and magnetism in kagome metals; local order beyond the average structure; lattice dynamics from RMC models
- [AI Agents](https://drthyang.github.io/agents/): how the AI agents in these tools are built: agents on tested scientific cores, with numbers and guardrails in code
- [Tools](https://drthyang.github.io/software/): the research software, with links to each web app and repository
- [Publications](https://drthyang.github.io/publications/): peer-reviewed papers and preprints, including first-author work in Nature Communications and JACS

## Tools

- [MATERIA Workbench](https://drthyang.github.io/materia-platform/): crystal and magnetic structure refinement in the browser (powder, single-crystal and PDF; X-ray or neutron) ([source](https://github.com/drthyang/materia-platform))
- [NEBULA3D](https://drthyang.github.io/nebula3d/): cleans 3D neutron or X-ray diffuse-scattering volumes and computes 3D-ΔPDF maps, in the browser or Python ([source](https://github.com/drthyang/nebula3d))
- [RMCProfile Workbench](https://drthyang.github.io/rmc-toolkits/): browser dashboard for reviewing RMCProfile refinements from a local run folder ([source](https://github.com/drthyang/rmc-toolkits))
- [RMC Phonon Dynamics](https://drthyang.github.io/rmc-phonon-dynamics/): phonon band structures, modes, simulated neutron spectra and DOS from RMCProfile ensembles ([source](https://github.com/drthyang/rmc-phonon-dynamics))
- [NeXus Viewer](https://drthyang.github.io/neutron-nexus-viewer/): quick looks at 3D neutron scattering volumes in the browser ([source](https://github.com/drthyang/neutron-nexus-viewer))
- [NEXPLAN](https://drthyang.github.io/nexplan/): neutron experiment planner for diffraction measurements (work in progress) ([source](https://github.com/drthyang/nexplan))
